_about: The Photos page (/photos/). Each photo's original is private/documents/photos/<file>.jpg (never uploaded). After adding or changing one here, run: powershell -File scripts/make-photos.ps1 to make the web copies. Captions are Patrick's facts only.
intro: Moments from my Army Reserve service.

photos.alt: A crew member in a flight helmet kneels on the open rear ramp of a Chinook helicopter in flight, looking out over green farmland.
photos.caption: On the open ramp of a CH-47 Chinook in flight.

photos.alt: A crew member sits on the open rear ramp of a Chinook in flight, with fields and a winding river far below.
photos.caption: The view from the back of a Chinook.

photos.alt: A Chinook lifts off over a green field under a blue sky with white clouds, a second Chinook on the ground behind it.
photos.caption: A Chinook over the field, with a second one on the ground.

photos.alt: A Chinook flies low over a grassy hill on an overcast day.
photos.caption: A Chinook coming in on a gray day.

photos.alt: A Chinook comes in low over a grassy hill on an overcast day, kicking up loose grass.
photos.caption: A Chinook landing at the 842nd.

photos.alt: Three soldiers seen from behind connect a black fuel hose to the side of a parked Chinook in a grassy field.
photos.caption: Connecting the fuel hose to a Chinook.

photos.alt: A Chinook sits in tall green grass with its rotors overhead while soldiers and a crew member work at its fuel panel.
photos.caption: Soldiers and aircrew at the fuel panel.

photos.alt: Close-up of soldiers and a crew member in a flight helmet connecting a fuel hose to an open panel on the side of a Chinook.
photos.caption: Hooking up the hose.

photos.alt: Two soldiers hold a fuel hose running into a parked Chinook while a crew member in a flight helmet stands nearby.
photos.caption: Fuel handlers and aircrew at work.

photos.alt: A Chinook sits in an open field on an overcast day while a group of soldiers stands beside a fuel hose and fire extinguisher.
photos.caption: Getting ready to refuel in the field.

photos.alt: Two soldiers stand by a fuel hose junction in a field of dry grass while others walk toward a parked Chinook.
photos.caption: Fuel lines laid out to the aircraft.

photos.alt: A soldier talks to a group gathered at the open rear ramp of a Chinook in a field of tall dry grass.
photos.caption: A briefing at the back of the aircraft.

photos.alt: A Black Hawk helicopter with its rotors turning is refueled by soldiers at an airfield fuel point, with hangars and mountains behind.
photos.caption: Refueling a Black Hawk at an airfield.

photos.alt: A Chinook parked on a sunny flight line with a fuel panel open on its side.
photos.caption: A Chinook on the flight line.

photos.alt: A Fuel System Supply Point: rows of large tan fuel bags inside framed berms, with tanker trucks and tents in the distance.
photos.caption: A Fuel System Supply Point (FSSP), like the one I had at the 842nd.

photos.alt: Soldiers kneel on a tan liner in the sand, fitting together the berm around a large fuel bag.
photos.caption: Putting together the berms.

photos.alt: Soldiers work among large tan fuel bags and hoses in a dirt field, with tents and mountains in the distance.
photos.caption: A fuel farm taking shape.

photos.alt: Inside a tan berm, a filled fuel bag sits connected to hoses while green tanker trucks line up behind.
photos.caption: Tankers lined up to fill the fuel bags.

photos.alt: Soldiers gather at a green tanker truck beside the fuel bags under light towers in the early morning.
photos.caption: An early start at the fuel farm.

photos.alt: Soldiers refuel two tan Humvees from a tanker truck on a spill berm, with a yellow spill kit nearby.
photos.caption: Refueling Humvees.

photos.alt: A smiling soldier walks past a line of tan Army trucks parked on spill berms for refueling.
photos.caption: Trucks lined up for fuel.

photos.alt: Soldiers stand by a fuel tanker as armored tracked vehicles pull up to be refueled.
photos.caption: Armored vehicles coming in for fuel.

photos.alt: Soldiers pass a fuel hose up to another soldier on top of a tan tracked vehicle under a clear blue sky.
photos.caption: Passing the hose up.

photos.alt: A large group of soldiers gathers around the open rear of a tan fuel truck in a motor pool.
photos.caption: Soldiers gathered at a fuel truck.

photos.alt: Soldiers on a gravel road between a cornfield and a white fence guide a bulldozer onto a low trailer.
photos.caption: Loading a bulldozer onto a trailer.

photos.alt: A soldier with his back to the camera uses hand signals to guide a bulldozer across a cleared field.
photos.caption: Ground-guiding a bulldozer.

photos.alt: Close-up of an olive green military bulldozer pushing a pile of earth and grass.
photos.caption: Moving earth.

photos.alt: Patrick Clark, wearing glasses and the rank of first lieutenant, speaks from a wooden podium.
photos.caption: Speaking at a ceremony.

photos.alt: Patrick Clark salutes an officer during a ceremony while a soldier holds the unit flag and a formation stands behind them.
photos.caption: Change of command ceremony.

photos.alt: Patrick Clark stands at attention facing an officer while a soldier holds the unit flag beside him.
photos.caption: Taking command.

photos.alt: Patrick Clark shakes hands with a newly promoted sergeant in front of the formation.
photos.caption: Congratulating a Soldier on his promotion from Specialist to Sergeant.

photos.alt: Soldiers stand in a wide circle in a dusty field camp under a blue sky while leaders address them.
photos.caption: Talking to the formation in the field.

photos.alt: A soldier shakes hands with a colonel and receives a coin beside a fuel berm, with Army trucks parked behind them.
photos.caption: A Soldier receiving a coin from a colonel for his work during annual training at Fort McCoy, Wisconsin.

photos.alt: Soldiers gather around a folding table in a pine forest camp with green tents behind them, looking at items laid out on the table.
photos.caption: Training in the field.

photos.alt: Soldiers in black Army PT shirts throw medicine balls and lift kettlebells at test lanes marked with cones on a grassy field.
photos.caption: Fitness test day.

photos.alt: Rows of small camouflage tents on cots under tall pine trees.
photos.caption: Home for the week.

photos.alt: A soldier sits on top of a vehicle looking out over a wide grassy training area and distant hills.
photos.caption: Looking out over the training area.

photos.alt: A camouflage Humvee drives along the edge of the surf on a beach, with a ship on the horizon.
photos.caption: A Humvee at the water's edge.

photos.alt: A camouflage Humvee sits stuck in deep beach sand while a helicopter flies overhead.
photos.caption: Stuck in the sand.

photos.alt: Soldiers relax and play in a dirt field between rows of tents at sunset.
photos.caption: Downtime at the end of the day.
